study.question: Can a globally pooled summary plus only the within-match-group attention redistribution outperform the strongest pooled reference and a fresh matched null, and does target-query information improve it over a history-query replacement?
study.hypothesis: Local observations, all single-seed: pooled_observed AUC=0.6302753101; balanced_target=0.6202303849. Fusion normalized target/context/uniform=0.6303714619/0.6303072794/0.6303333801; raw target/context=0.6307203237/0.6303822658. Radius target/context=0.6306798923/0.6302537604 and pooled_reference=0.6307714975, so neither extra raw direction nor radius has established incremental utility over the strongest null. Empirical target/context/uniform=0.6303523996/0.6303489998/0.6300724490: replacing balanced group masses failed to improve the stronger reference and removed the target/context contrast. Diagnostics reported balanced/empirical prior L1=0.6793 on 512 impressions, which confirms an intervention, not its explanation. The empirical-uniform and pooled-reference inputs nearly agree but their trained AUC differs by 0.00069905; numerical/training trajectory variation or an unresolved implementation confound is therefore consequential. Provisional mechanism: balanced raw attention combines within-group redistribution with a redundant balanced-uniform baseline. Preserve global pooling and cancel only that baseline, retaining balanced amplification of rare-group deviations; this may expose incremental information without substituting empirical masses. It may also simply fail. A fresh null and query replacement are necessary; no complementary mechanism is yet established. Authorized history contains successful executions including negative scientific outcomes; no failed execution is exposed and previous_runtime_error is null. Agent-memory searches for fusion/empirical returned no hits, not evidence of no prior work.

nearest_work.source_ref: paper:din; arXiv:1706.06978v4; content-sha256:5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2; primary section 4.3 lines 250-277 read through tools.py
nearest_work.difference: Inherit target-conditioned relevance scoring, not DIN reproduction. DIN abandons softmax to retain intensity; this proposal retains within-group softmax and subtracts balanced uniform weights before adding a global pooled summary. No new embeddings, fields, events, losses or generated queries. Broader priority/novelty unverified.

README verifies category/brand/type behavior fields without item identity; no item embedding or matching objective is invented. Publisher full paper remains unavailable; no detailed DMR mechanism claim.

Exact source is preserved with original final class renamed. New final class retains all parameter allocations but supplies global pool plus signed within-group attention correction to the same fusion head. Null correction is zero. Closest local method, not a new general attention invention.

Observed outcomes motivate retaining balanced redistribution rather than empirical mass. Unlike empirical w, new summary is p + (r_balanced - r_uniform_balanced), implemented by subtracting weights before contraction. This preserves 1/K weighting of within-group deviations and globally pooled baseline; no claim of superiority before evaluation.

inherited_components: Complete pooled_observed predictor and all identity, context, repeat, overlap, transition and gap residuals, preserved source and initialization.
Existing category/brand/action/log-age embeddings and target-match partition; static fields remain available exactly as before.
Existing PReLU relevance scorer, separate category/brand reads and equal occupied-group mass from balanced_target/fusion ancestry.
Existing zero-final-weight 548-to-32-to-1 bias-free fusion head, 17568 parameters; total expected 17270691, of which 4226 scorer parameters.
Fixed host training, validation scorer, seeds and ownership boundary; no additional history or labels.
study.proposed_difference: Let p be the global mean of category+brand+action+recency, u_i=1/(K*n_g) for event i in occupied match group g, and wc,wb be the existing balanced learned field weights. Set delta=sum_i[(wc_i-u_i)c_i+(wb_i-u_i)b_i+0.5*(wc_i+wb_i-2*u_i)common_i]; summary=p+delta. This adds a signed attention correction, not a probability-weighted average; every group has zero correction mass. The complete pooled predictor and existing fusion head are unchanged. Uniform sets scorer output scale to zero and executes the same allocations and readout path, giving delta=0. Context replaces only query embeddings by history category/brand means, preserving target-based partitions. No temperature, trainable gate, scaling hyperparameter, optimizer or capacity change is introduced.
predictions: All cells allocate exactly the same 17270691 parameters and preserve parent initialization; the head initially contributes zero. Context and target have equal active scorer capacity; null has equal allocated but lower active capacity.

Group-centered-value loop oracle and direct weight-centering agree within floating-point tolerance; per-group delta mass is near zero, masked contributions are zero, empty and zero-length summaries are zero, and singleton delta is zero. Uniform correction should be exactly zero and reproduce a pooled-input predictor at fixed weights.

If baseline contamination was consequential, centered_target exceeds fresh centered_null and frozen pooled_reference in full validation AUC; target-specific support additionally requires exceeding centered_context. Balanced delta differs from empirical-delta where group sizes differ, retaining rare-group within-group changes.

Useful direction must survive paired repetitions and show acceptable measured quality/cost tradeoff. Representation witness sensitivity alone does not imply prediction utility. Report Logloss independently and all null/negative outcomes.
falsifiers: Failing source/oracle, empty/padding/finite-output or null-reconstruction checks invalidates this implementation and calls for correction before mechanism interpretation; failed costs remain charged.
Centered_target does not beat the stronger of centered_null and g3-r0020-pooled_reference: no evidence of incremental utility for this implementation.
Centered_context matches/exceeds target: target-query incremental explanation unsupported even if both beat null; target-defined groups still prevent claiming complete target independence.

Advantage reverses or disappears under paired seeds, or is comparable with the existing 0.00069905 difference between nearly equivalent pooled null trajectories: single-seed complementarity remains unestablished.
Measured cost increase is not offset by quality on the observed cost frontier: no efficiency claim. No matched-GPU-compute causal comparison is available from equal-epoch results alone.
alternative_explanations: Seed and floating-point/parallel training trajectory variation, repeated adaptive validation selection, or unresolved implementation differences among nominal pooling nulls.

Additional active scorer capacity or changed gradients through existing embeddings, rather than target-specific information; context controls active capacity but cannot eliminate every optimization explanation.
Balanced centering changes signed coordinate scale, head conditioning and gradient geometry; a gain cannot uniquely establish redundant-evidence removal.
No useful information beyond existing group means/histograms/recurrence statistics, coarse category/brand identities, or insufficient three-epoch optimization.
First-512 diagnostics may not represent the population; history_match groups remain target-defined in the history-query control; static snapshot as-of dates remain undocumented.
